sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Dallas Cowboys have released their inactive lists ahead of tonight’s Thursday Night Football matchup at AT&T Stadium. For Tampa Bay, there are no surprises among the players dealing with injuries. Quarterback Baker Mayfield, safety Antoine Winfield Jr., linebacker SirVocea Dennis and cornerback Benjamin Morrison were all ruled out on Wednesday […]
